Buildings.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

Machinery and equipment.label: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
Machinery and equipment.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

Construction in progress.label: Construction in Progress, Gross
Construction in progress.description: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

Property, plant and equipment, net.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
Property, plant and equipment, net.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

outstanding balance on Japan loan facili.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
outstanding balance on Japan loan facili.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.
outstanding balance on Japan loan facili.metric_type: outstanding balance on Japan loan facility

weighted average interest rates on short.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
weighted average interest rates on short.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
weighted average interest rates on short.metric_type: weighted average interest rates on short-term borrowings

capitalized interest.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
capitalized interest.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

outstanding balance.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
outstanding balance.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

authorized.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
authorized.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

Total actuarial losses recognized in Acc.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
Total actuarial losses recognized in Acc.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.
Total actuarial losses recognized in Acc.metric_type: Total actuarial losses recognized in Accumulated other comprehensive loss for pension plans

Total shareholders\u2019 equity.label: Equity Method Investments
Total shareholders\u2019 equity.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

Total assets.label: Assets
Total assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

Accrued balance of interest and penaltie.label: Accrued Liabilities, Current
Accrued balance of interest and penaltie.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).
Accrued balance of interest and penaltie.metric_type: Accrued balance of interest and penalties

Goodwill.label: Goodwill
Goodwill.description: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

Gross Carrying Amount.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Gross Carrying Amount.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

short-term borrowings.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-term Investments
short-term borrowings.description: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

Current liability.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
Current liability.description: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

Non-current liability.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
Non-current liability.description: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

Net liability recognized.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
Net liability recognized.description: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

Net actuarial (gain) loss.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
Net actuarial (gain) loss.description: Amount of loss from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

Prior service cost.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
Prior service cost.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

Service cost.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
Service cost.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

Interest cost.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
Interest cost.description: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

Expected return on plan assets.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
Expected return on plan assets.description: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

Recognized net actuarial (gain) loss.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
Recognized net actuarial (gain) loss.description: Amount of loss from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

Net periodic benefit cost.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
Net periodic benefit cost.description: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

Ending balance at December 31, 2023.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Ending balance at December 31, 2023.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

Ending balance at December 31, 2024.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Ending balance at December 31, 2024.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

shares outstanding.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
shares outstanding.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

Segment Assets.label: Assets
Segment Assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

uncommitted short-term bank credit lines.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-term Investments
uncommitted short-term bank credit lines.description: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

Net cash provided by operating activitie.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
Net cash provided by operating activitie.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.
Net cash provided by operating activitie.metric_type: Net cash provided by operating activities

Short-term investments.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-term Investments
Short-term investments.description: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

Cash paid for amounts included in the me.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.metric_type: Cash paid for amounts included in the measurement of lease liabilities

Net cash paid for income taxes.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
Net cash paid for income taxes.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income, net of any cash received during the current period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.
Net cash paid for income taxes.metric_type: Net cash paid for income taxes

Total inventories.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
Total inventories.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

Deferred compensation plan assets.label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
Deferred compensation plan assets.description: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

Supplementary pension plan assets.label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
Supplementary pension plan assets.description: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

uncommitted short-term bank credit lines.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-term Investments
uncommitted short-term bank credit lines.description: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.
uncommitted short-term bank credit lines.metric_type: uncommitted short-term bank credit lines in use
